doc: Start sites of the training bots (owner, 2026-11-02: good training locations, decimals ignored). Bot k of every shard starts every episode at sites[k], so bot k of shard 0 and bot k of shard 1 form a pair: the same seed, the same start, different worlds (self-imitation). Owner's coordinates are feet positions read in the training world, seed 20261101 (checked: site 2 is grass at y 68, air at y 69). src/rl/run_skill_env.js --sites.
